{"consolidated_memory":"**build/bazel/BUILD.bazel: Cache Miss Storm Issues (Two Occasions)**

COMPONENT: build/bazel/BUILD.bazel (Starlark, build system)
PROBLEM TYPE: Cache miss storm in the build graph
REPRODUCTION: Build twice with no source change
SIGNAL: Rebuild of targets that should have been cached
COVERING CHECK: Remote cache hit rate check in CI

---

**OCCASION 1: 2026-01-11**
- SPECIFIC TRIGGER: Records carrying non-ASCII names
- ROOT CAUSE: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- FIX: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR: #3055 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-1
- RESULT: Cold start performance improved 52%, down to 698 ms

**OCCASION 2: 2026-02-26**
- SPECIFIC TRIGGER: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- ROOT CAUSE: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- FIX: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR: #9412 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-2
- RESULT: Reclaimed 10 GB of blob storage"}
